test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is/are true about NABARD?

I. NABARD was formed on the recommendation of Sivaraman Committee.

II. NABARD came into existence in 1980.

III. It was set up with an initial capital of Rs. 100 crore.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only I and III**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **NABARD** was established on the recommendations of the **Sivaraman Committee** (Committee to Review Arrangements for Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development).
 
• **NABARD** came into existence on **12 July 1982**, not in 1980.
 
• It was set up with an initial capital of **Rs. 100 crore**, which was raised to Rs. 5000 crore fully subscribed by the Government of India and the Reserve Bank of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NABARD** stands for **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development**.

 
 
• It is an apex development financial institution in India.
 
• It is responsible for providing and regulating credit and other facilities to promote and develop agriculture, small-scale industries, cottage and village industries, handicrafts, and other rural crafts.
 
• NABARD also supports all other allied economic activities in rural areas, with a view to promoting integrated rural development and securing prosperity for rural areas.
 
• It is involved in policy planning and operations relating to agriculture and other economic activities in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Sivaraman Committee**
 
 
• The Committee to Review Arrangements for Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development, also known as the Sivaraman Committee, was set up by the Reserve Bank of India in 1979.
 
• The committee was chaired by B. Sivaraman.
 
• Its recommendations led to the establishment of NABARD to address the credit needs of the agricultural and rural sectors.
